transcript:
Robot: Good evening everyone. I have been asked to roast a comedian tonight. I looked at his career graph, it's flatter than his joke. Please welcome Bunty. Bunty, tera stand-up dekh ke log motivate hote hain comedy chhod dene ke liye. Tu anti-motivation hai. [Bunty, seeing your stand-up, people get motivated to quit comedy. You are anti-motivation.]
Bunty: Are are robot saab bahut English jhaad rahe hain. Hindi mein bol, asli mazaa Hindi mein aata hai. [Hey Mr. Robot, you're showing off too much English. Speak in Hindi, the real fun is in Hindi.]
Robot: Achha, Hindi mein mazaa aata hai? Tab to tere shows mein bahut mazaa aata hoga. Isiliye to last show mein 11 log the. Aur English ki baat karta hai tu. Yaad hai tera wo tweet? "I was went to Mumbai for show but show was cancel." Bunty, "I was went" kya hota hai? "I went" hota hai. Aur "show was cancel" nahi, "show was cancelled". Teri English past mein bhi nahi thi aur present mein bhi nahi hai. [Oh, fun in Hindi? Then your shows must be very fun. That's why in the last show there were 11 people. And you talk about English. Remember your tweet? "I was went to Mumbai for show but show was cancel." Bunty, what is "I was went"? It is "I went". And not "show was cancel", "show was cancelled". Your English was neither in the past nor is it in the present.]
Bunty: Grammar police ban gaya tu? Robot hai, Google se utha ke bol raha hai. [Have you become the grammar police? You're a robot, speaking by picking from Google.]
Robot: Haan, main Google se uthata hoon. Tu kahan se uthata hai? Kyunki tere jokes bhi original nahi hain aur teri English bhi nahi. Tujhe pata hai tera International Comedy Festival ka application kyun reject hua? Requirements mein likha tha "Must be able to perform a 10-minute set in English." Tune Hindi mein demo bheja. Unhone reply kiya "Thank you for your interest." Wo interest nahi tha Bunty, wo insult tha polite English mein. [Yes, I pick from Google. Where do you pick from? Because neither your jokes are original nor your English. Do you know why your International Comedy Festival application was rejected? The requirements said "Must be able to perform a 10-minute set in English." You sent a demo in Hindi. They replied "Thank you for your interest." That wasn't interest, Bunty, that was an insult in polite English.]
Bunty: English aati hai mujhe, bas thodi kamzor hai. [I know English, it's just a bit weak.]
Robot: Thodi kamzor? Bunty, teri English ICU mein hai, life support pe. Ek kaam kar, 'English Seekho' app download kar. Expert ke chhote-chhote video hain, Hindi mein samjhate hain. Aur ek AI coach hai, 24 ghante available. Wo tujhse 500 baar galti karwayegi, har baar sudharegi. [A bit weak? Bunty, your English is in the ICU, on life support. Do one thing, download the 'English Seekho' app. There are short videos by experts, explaining in Hindi. And there is an AI coach, available 24 hours. She will make you make mistakes 500 times and correct you every time.]
Bunty: Kitna lagega? [How much will it cost?]
Robot: ₹1 ka trial hai, ₹1. Tera sabse sasta investment hoga aur pehli baar profitable bhi. Ek mahine mein confidence aayega, English mein perform kar payega. [It's a ₹1 trial, ₹1. It will be your cheapest investment and for the first time, profitable too. In one month, confidence will come, you will be able to perform in English.]
Bunty: Thik hai, thik hai, download kar raha hoon. [Okay, okay, I am downloading.]
Robot: Ladies and gentlemen, Bunty ne 'English Seekho' app download kiya. Aaj ka roast successful raha. 'English Seekho' app, expert se seekho, AI coach se practice karo. ₹1 ka trial. Bunty afford kar sakta hai, tum bhi kar sakte ho. [Ladies and gentlemen, Bunty downloaded the 'English Seekho' app. Today's roast was successful. 'English Seekho' app, learn from experts, practice with an AI coach. ₹1 trial. Bunty can afford it, you can too.]
Voiceover: To install button pe click karo aur 'English Seekho' app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the 'English Seekho' app.]
summary: An AI robot roasts a stand-up comedian on stage for his poor English grammar and pronunciation, which led to his international festival rejection. The robot recommends the 'English Seekho' app, highlighting its expert videos, 24/7 AI coach, and a ₹1 trial to build confidence.
